text:
maria: noticing a spike of GPU node join failures in eu-west-1, lots of KMS decrypt errors in the keystore logs since ~08:03 UTC
ashok: saw the alert, linking: https://grafana.company/internal/d/alerts/gpu-join-failures ? :eyes:
sre-bot: Alert: region=eu-west-1 metric=gpu_node_join_fail rate=18m, threshold=10m (fired at 08:04 UTC)
jordan: did we push any network/firewall changes in that region during the maintenance window?
maria: there was a small ACL tweak on the privnet by infra at 07:50 — changed outbound to be default-deny for ephemeral proxies
jordan: that matches — the keystore proxy uses ephemeral egress from the warm-pool subnets to the keystore service. If egress blocked, nodes cannot fetch/decrypt session keys
leah: can you paste a sample error from the node? need to confirm it's KMS access denied, not service certificate issue
maria: ```
2026-03-21T08:03:21Z ERROR keystore: decrypt failed client=gpu-node-124 DecryptError AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333:key/abcd-ef01
CausedBy: policy denies kms:Decrypt from src=10.2.3.45:44123
```
ashok: confirmed, this looks like egress -> keystore proxy (443) being denied by the ACL change. That would surface as KMS Decrypt 403s downstream
jordan: quick mitigation options: 1) rollback the ACL change, 2) add temporary allow for privnet warm-pool CIDr to keystore-proxy, 3) route keystore traffic via a different NAT. Rollback is fastest
maria: rollback would be fastest, but infra is running that change as part of a larger deploy — might be risky for other teams
leah: from a security/compliance angle, a short rollback for 30 minutes with audit logging on the exception is acceptable. We need to preserve audit trail and postmortem action to tighten scope
sre-bot: Suggested playbook: `rollback-acl -> ingests succeed -> verify node join rate -> escalate if not resolved`. Playbook link: https://playbooks.company/keystore-egress
ashok: also we should temporarily increase keystore audit sampling from 1% to 100% for the window so we capture all failed decrypts for forensics
jordan: I can add a specific allow rule: src=10.2.3.0/24 dst=keystore-proxy.eu-west-1.svc:443 for 45m. If approved, I’ll push now
maria: approve from infra ops — go ahead. please add a short TTL and tag the change with `incident=keystore-eu-warmup`
ordan: (typo) meant jordan: pushing rule now -> `terraform apply -target=module.firewall.rule.keystore-temp-allow`
ashok: while that goes, can we trigger a manual rejoin attempt for the stuck nodes? `kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/gpu-warmup`
maria: running restart now, nodes should attempt decrypt again once they reach the proxy
jordan: pushed rule, plan shows +1 ingress rule, TTL=45m, change id tf-apply-8391, tagging with incident=keystore-eu-warmup
sre-bot: Change detected: tf-apply-8391 applied by jordan at 08:10 UTC. New rule: allow 10.2.3.0/24->keystore-proxy:443 TTL=2700s
maria: seeing decrypt success on node gpu-node-124 at 08:11:05, join progressed from 2/min -> 12/min
ashok: monitoring join rate and keystore 403s. Keystore 403s dropped from ~150/min to ~3/min in the last 5m :white_check_mark:
leah: good short fix. Please capture ACL diff and attach to incident ticket. We still need a long-term fix: tighten the rule to service account destinations instead of broad subnet, and revisit ephemeral key rotation windows
maria: creating incident ticket: INC-2026-0421, attaching logs and TF change id tf-apply-8391
jordan: follow-up action: will change firewall template to require explicit allow for keystore proxy when ephemeral warm-pool enabled; add a pre-deploy check so the ACL tweak will be blocked if warm-pool is active
ashok: also adding a monitor that alerts if keystore decrypt error rate > 5/min for > 3m in any region (to catch early)
maria: note: warm-pool rejoin created a small cost bump due to extra node churn — will include cost delta in postmortem
leah: after we close, we should update compliance runbook with an emergency-exception flow and approval scope (security + infra + oncall)
sre-bot: Incident resolved (tentative): keystore egress allow applied at 08:10, validation shows normal join rates at 08:15. Please confirm for final closure
maria: confirmed by infra at 08:25 UTC — closing for now. Will post postmortem by EOD with audit logs and remediation plan :memo:
